name: Vishwas Refoils & Consumer
summary: Vishwas Refoils & Consumer, a Rajkot business that started as a proprietorship in 1996 and was incorporated as a company in March 2023, buys refined edible oils and processes, packs and sells them under the "Vishwas" brand, and makes filtered mustard oil; Gujarat brought in 93.7% of FY26 revenue. Revenue jumped from ₹79.8 cr in FY24 to ₹310.3 cr in FY26 and profit after tax rose 84.7% to ₹5.06 cr in FY26, but the net margin is thin at 1.6% and operating cash flow was only ₹0.50 cr. The ₹25.78 cr issue is all fresh money, with ₹19.30 cr going to a new edible oil refining facility; debt to equity was 0.72 before the issue. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 17.0x, slightly above the 15.5x median of the two listed peers, and the price to book of about 2.1x is above theirs.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹79.79 cr (FY24) to ₹310.26 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 97.2%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹79.79 cr, ₹237.29 cr, ₹310.26 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.72 in FY26 (borrowings ₹10.79 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 27% (₹8.47 cr in FY24 to ₹10.79 cr in FY26) while revenue nearly quadrupled.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose from ₹3.87 cr (FY24) to ₹6.95 cr (FY25) and ₹15.04 cr (FY26); the source table lists the years in reverse, but ₹15.04 cr matches the ₹22.53 NAV per share.

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹0.50 cr in FY26, about 10% of the ₹5.06 cr profit, after negative flows in FY24 and FY25.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 84.7% in FY26, from ₹2.74 cr to ₹5.06 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from 0.91% (FY24) to 1.15% (FY25) and 1.63% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 45.91% in FY26, down from 50.49% in FY25, on a small equity base.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 33.86% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer profit or EBITDA margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 17.0x (₹85.94 cr market cap on 95,49,060 shares at ₹90 ÷ ₹5.06 cr FY26 PAT) vs a peer median of 15.5x (Kriti Nutrients 9.4x, M. K. Proteins 21.6x), about 10% above.

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.1x (₹85.94 cr ÷ ₹40.82 cr, i.e. ₹15.04 cr FY26 net worth + ₹25.78 cr fresh issue) vs a peer median of about 1.65x derived from their P/E, EPS and NAV, about 27% above.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue market cap to FY26 revenue is about 0.28x (₹85.94 cr ÷ ₹310.26 cr), but peer market cap to sales figures were not found.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: No details of share issues or transfers in the 12 months before the IPO were found in public sources.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 59.05% after the issue, down from 84.34%.

checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters or directors was found.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The entire ₹25.78 cr issue is a fresh issue of 28,64,000 shares; there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The ₹25.78 cr issue is about 30.0% of the ₹85.94 cr post-issue market cap.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹19.30 cr, about 75% of the ₹25.78 cr issue, funds a new edible oil refining facility.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: None of the issue goes to repaying debt; the only objects are the refining facility and general corporate purposes.
